title: Quoted-Printable The equal sign at the end of the line indicates a soft line break
summary: The equal sign followed by CRLF indicates line breaks for transmission. The equal sign and line breaks are removed together during decoding.
applies: Binary encoding; file and value dumps
detail: =3D represents a literal equal sign. The results after restoration of ordinary hard line breaks and soft line breaks are different.
boundary: The Q encoding of the MIME header encoded-word has additional rules, and underscores in the text cannot be replaced with spaces.
relevance: Avoid introducing extra line breaks or losing real equal signs when recovering long text from the message body.
